name: Littjara Mirrorlake
oracle_text:
This land enters tapped.
{T}: Add {U}.
{2}{G}{G}{U}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Create a token that's a copy of target creature you control, except it enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it. Activate only as a sorcery.
blocked_sentences: {2}{G}{G}{U}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Create a token that's a copy of target creature you control, except it enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it. Activate only as a sorcery.

needs.what: a `counters` option on `copy_permanent` (map of counter kind to value expression, e.g. {"+1/+1": {"const": 1}}) passed through to primitives.create_token's `enters_with`, so each token copy enters the battlefield with the counters already on it (122.6, 614.1c) rather than having them put on afterwards
needs.why_existing_wont_do: copy_permanent's options (amount, as, attacking, controller, embalm, except/except_, objects, or_planeswalker, tapped) have no counters key, and its except_ overrides only copiable values (power, toughness, types, subtypes, keywords, name, colors, mana cost), not counters. create_token has `counters` (enters_with) but names a fixed token id and cannot copy a target. copy_permanent with `as` followed by add_counters on the binding puts the counter on after the token has entered, which differs from 'enters with' for its enters-triggers and anything that reads how it entered
